notes: Mage trio v2: Frost, Arcane and Fire share one skeleton (same bar, round socket, well, keycap and end-cap footprint); only materials, colours and the end-cap signature differ. Contrast measured on final-empty.jpg by the WCAG formula against the mean luminance of the lightest tenth of the pixels under the two text lines' boxes. Socket r is the dark glass disc; ring_r is the outer metal ring. Ring spans y 256-790 (about 1.23x the bar's height). Animate as layers: a sharp glint sweeping across the ice crystal's facets and a slow cold pulse in its core; the faint icy-blue inner light along the well's edges breathing; a cold shimmer travelling along the ice band's top highlight; the frost feathers at the ends slowly growing in and fading.
